page: OVHcloud b2-15 is a general-purpose virtual server hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Haswell processor with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs running at 2.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 15.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB per core, alongside 100 GB of local SSD storage. It does not include a GPU.

Benchmark results indicate that the CPU performance is relatively modest, with single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores falling into the bottom 10% and 25% categories, respectively. Multi-core performance is similarly constrained, registering in the bottom 25%. However, memory performance is more balanced; the Passmark memory score, small-block cached read-only memory bandwidth, and Redis SET operations all perform in the middle 50% tier. Static web serving and large-block memory bandwidth are weaker, placing in the bottom 25%.

Given its older Intel Haswell architecture and dedicated core allocation, the b2-15 offers a stable, predictable resource profile for entry-level workloads where high-compute throughput is not critical. The inclusion of local SSD storage and a complimentary public IPv4 address adds utility for basic hosting. This server is best suited for general-purpose workloads such as lightweight database operations, text processing, Redis caching, and small-scale web serving.
